domain: ORGANIZER HYBRID SYNTHETIC; provisional forensic labels, not field accuracy

plan.matching_contract: Full-frame bbox overlap is a provisional localization candidate, not proof of inserted support. Sampled diagnostics establish exact original-point membership via cluster_source_indices. Components with at least 50% inserted support are distinguished from mixed background components; this is an evaluation attribution rule, not a detector setting.
plan.limits: Forensic source-support reconstruction, not organizer-provided labels or field accuracy. Every frame with inferred insertions is inspected through original-point provenance. First detections are actual frame onsets under the stated majority attribution rule; mixed infrastructure components are reported separately. No tuning of detector configuration.

post_insertion_tail.validity: No inferred appended points; not independently exhaustively reviewed real negatives.
